hero.title: From concept to factory.
hero.subtitle: Product development, manufacturing optimisation, and test infrastructure.
hero.intro:
Swiss engineering consultancy.
We develop products from initial concept to series production. We redesign existing products and take over manufacturing - typically at a fraction of current production costs.

Industrial design, mechanical engineering, electronics, embedded systems - one team, every stage. 100,000+ units delivered to market.
hero.location: Based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Manufacturing partners in Switzerland, France, the UK and China.

product.title: Product development
product.desc: From initial concept to series production. Industrial design, mechanical engineering, electronics, and embedded systems. We handle requirements, prototyping, validation, and manufacturing ramp-up. Repairability, end-of-life, and environmental impact considered from the start.

redesign.title: Redesign for manufacturing
redesign.desc: Product too expensive or too slow to produce. We analyse the design, identify cost drivers, and redesign for faster assembly, lower unit cost, and reduced defect rate. Component rationalisation, process optimisation.

electronics.title: Electronics & embedded systems
electronics.desc: Circuit board design, embedded firmware, power systems, sensor integration. We design for production constraints from the start - tooling and test requirements are part of the initial specification.

testbench.title: Test bench design & automation
testbench.desc: Custom test benches for production validation. Automated test sequences, repeatable across stations, scalable to production volumes. We use TofuPilot as test engine and analytics platform - we contribute to its development and request features directly.

industrial.title: Industrialisation & manufacturing
industrial.desc: Supply chain setup, production launch, quality control, certification. We manage the full production cycle with our manufacturing partners - typically at a fraction of current production costs.

network.title: Manufacturing network
network.desc: Direct partnerships with manufacturers including Micro Manufacturing Limited in Shenzhen. Precision manufacturing in Switzerland and France, volume production in southern China - selected and qualified per project.

transfer.title: Technology transfer
transfer.desc: Production relocation between China and Europe, in both directions. Documentation, tooling adaptation, supplier qualification, process validation at the new site.

uav.title: Production test benches for professional and military UAVs
uav.desc: Designed, deployed, and operated production test benches for professional and military mapping UAVs.
uav.keywords: UAV, drone, test benches, automation, validation

elec.title: R&D and industrialisation for airborne medical container
elec.desc: Electronics R&D, fault investigation on existing systems, subcontractor management, industrialisation, production management.

radar.title: Automated test systems for military radar
radar.desc: Performance test systems for military radar platforms. Automated test sequences, data acquisition, and pass/fail determination.
radar.keywords: Military, radar, defence, embedded, MATLAB, automation

devrel.title: IoT device - concept to production
devrel.desc: Specification, circuit board design, firmware, prototyping, and small series production of an IoT device.
devrel.scope: Product design, circuit board design, prototyping, small batch production

cubesat.title: CubeSat development coordination
cubesat.desc: Project coordination, PCB design, and systems integration for a research CubeSat.
cubesat.keywords: CubeSat, PCB design, systems integration, space

discover.title: Specify
discover.desc: Define requirements, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Regulatory landscape, manufacturing constraints, target unit cost - established before design work begins.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.desc: Iterate on electronics, mechanics, and firmware. Functional prototypes to validate performance and identify integration issues before production commitment.

validate.title: Validate
validate.desc: Custom test benches, validation plans, test data acquisition. Repeatable test procedures that transition directly into production quality control.

industrial.title: Industrialise
industrial.desc: Partner selection, tooling, production ramp-up. We manage the transition from validated prototype to series production.

support.title: Support
support.desc: Test infrastructure maintenance, production support, sustaining engineering. Calibration and validation throughout the product lifecycle.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: New product, production issue, or technology transfer - get in touch by phone or email.
